utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did we decide what needs fixing first for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think the leaky roof and the broken front steps should come first—they’re the biggest safety issues.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That makes sense. Do we have anyone lined up to handle those first?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a hand if you need any tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus. I’m not sure yet—I’ll check what’s missing and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah. Just give me a shout when you know, and I’ll see what I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right—the repair drive. I heard folks are still gathering tools and donations, so I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess—please do. I’m mostly worried about whether we’ll have enough tools and a clear drop-off plan.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around about the tool count and where they’re setting up the drop-off spot, then I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you head over to the community center and check in at the repair drive table?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’ll head over there and check in at the repair drive table now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m telling everyone about the repair drive — if you know anyone who wants to help, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear of anyone.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Uli! I’ll keep spreading the word too—every extra pair of hands helps.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo, I’m glad you reached out — I’m putting together the repair drive now. What do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hi Rosa, I can help sort tools or carry a few things. Just let me know where to start.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s great, Leo — could you start by helping me sort the tools into labels and piles? After that, I may have you carry a few boxes over to the hall.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what needs repairing and when the drive is happening? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, it’s the usual stuff—bikes, a leaky faucet, and a couple of loose chairs. I’m pretty sure the repair drive is this Saturday afternoon at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — bikes, a leaky faucet, and loose chairs this Saturday afternoon at the community hall. I’ll keep that in mind.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — I’m happy to help coordinate around the school schedule. What do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — could you help line up a couple volunteers and check which afternoons work best after school? I can put together the repair list and share it with you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I can ask around for a couple volunteers and see which after-school afternoons work best. Once you send the repair list, I’ll match it up with people’s availability.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a little behind, so I’d love the quick version if you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — it’s just a neighborhood effort to collect tools, spare parts, and a bit of cash so we can help fix up a few things around the block. I can give you the quick list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes please — the quick list would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just send me the basics and where to drop it off.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — I’ll send the basics and the drop-off spot in a minute. Just confirming, you’re definitely good to help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, definitely. Just send the basics and I’ll handle the drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is getting set up soon—what kind of help do they still need?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive! I think they still need folks to sort donations and maybe help with small fixes, but I’d better check so I don’t tell you the wrong thing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be helpful—I can sort donations if they need an extra pair of hands. Let me know what you find out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll bring it up with the neighbors and see who can help with the repair drive. Then I’ll let you know what we can put together.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an eye on what we have here and be ready to add to the list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll check back with everyone and see what we can get lined up. I’ll let you know as soon as I have anything solid.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive got a pretty good turnout today—folks were dropping off all kinds of things. Did Rey say if they still need volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure, but I can ask around and see if they still need help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, I’d appreciate that. If they still need hands, I can swing by after errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I meant to bring something by; what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We still need a few tools and some spare parts—if you can swing by with either, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can do that—I'll check my shed and bring whatever tools I can find. If I’m missing the parts, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I was just about to ask what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly just sorting the donations and moving the bigger items. If you can help with loading, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can help with the loading. Just point me to the bigger items.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll make a simple list and let you know exactly what tools to bring.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs fixing, and when are you thinking of doing it?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great, thank you! I’m still sorting the list, but I’ll send out the details soon and loop you in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good—send it when you’re ready, and I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds great — I can help spread the word and see who needs a hand. What time and place are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m thinking Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center parking lot. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, that works for me! I’ll be there at 10 and can help get people organized.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I’ll keep it moving. Let’s make sure everyone knows where to drop off tools and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ll help keep an eye on the supplies and point folks to the drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — that helps a lot. I’ll post the drop-off details and swing by to check on things as folks arrive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive happening soon—did I get that right? If you know more, I’d love the update.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, that’s right. What do you need fixed—I can tell you when and where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mina. I’m mostly just trying to figure out when and where it’ll be, so I can pass it along correctly.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, what's the repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s a neighborhood drive to gather broken appliances and small repairs people need help with, especially around school hours so families can drop things off easily.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — what time should I drop by, and is there a list of what you’re accepting?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, great—can you confirm you’re actually able to help, and if so, what day works for you?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I can help. Saturday works best for me—just let me know what you need me to do.
